$schema.description: Editor hint: path to the JSON Schema of this file.

id.description: Stable lowercase UUID v4 identity of the element. Assigned by tooling at creation and never reused; a rename keeps it.

schema.description: PostgreSQL schema of the function; defaultSchema when absent.

name.description: Name of the function in its CREATE FUNCTION statement.

function.description: SQL function of the sibling .sql file.

callers.description: Role purposes that get EXECUTE on the function; empty — no application role, only other functions of the owner call it.

action.description: A word of the action vocabulary or the name of a custom action of the object.

kind.description: Kind of the referenced metadata object.

name.description: Logical name of the referenced object.

object.description: Metadata object whose rights contract is checked.

row.description: Name of the uuid IN parameter that holds the primary key of the checked row.

scope.description: Name of the uuid IN parameter that holds the scope value of the check.

check.description: Rights check the function applies before it acts on behalf of the caller.

items.description: Declaration of one function of the sibling .sql file.

functions.description: Declarations of functions of the sibling .sql file, sorted by function (entries without schema first, then by schema and name) and without duplicates.

description: Declarations of SQL functions: who may execute them and which rights check they apply.
